races.verdict: Sole 3-y-o MYTHOLOGICAL STAR stands out as a progressive sort in this line-up and is taken to make light of a 6 lb penalty for last week's Ffos Las success. Post Rider has been given a chance by the handicapper and it wouldn't be a surprise to see her bounce back to form and provide the chief threat. MYTHOLOGICAL STAR (IRE) POST RIDER GOLDEN CIRCET (IRE)
